description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeEducationDao in the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup, test cases for CRUD operations, and search functionality related to employee education records.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationDaoTest
classes.description: A test suite for EmployeeEducationDao, verifying methods like fetching, saving, deleting, and searching employee education records.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of EmployeeEducationDao, and populates test data.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEducationById
methods.description: Tests retrieving an employee education record by ID.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Tests deletion of employee education records.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Tests searching employee education with filters.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeEducationWithLimit
methods.description: Tests searching employee education with a limit.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Tests saving (creating) a new employee education record.

methods.name: testEditEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Tests editing (updating) an existing employee education record.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeEducationsCount
methods.description: Tests retrieving the count of employee education records matching search criteria.
